items.title: 'The Guild' movie revival becomes highest-funded Kickstarter film ever, filling me with millennial nostalgia and making me very nervous
items.summary: Massively multi-funded online roleplaying movie.

content.v: As a millennial (boo, hiss) born in the 90s, I was just old enough to enjoy The Guild , a YouTube series about a group of dysfunctional MMO players, when it debuted online in 2007. 12-year-old me, who'd just gotten big into World of Warcraft and online games in general was downright invested—but that was then, and this is now.

I am currently 31 (also boo, also hiss) and I've got a lot less hair, which is part of why I was honestly surprised when I awoke to the news this week that The Guild: Ren Faire'd has become the highest-funded Kickstarter movie of all time—and one of the most successfully-funded movies to be fuelled by crowdfunding.

If you head on over to Kickstarter and apply the correct filters on its search function , you'll see it playing second fiddle to Critical Role: The Legend of Vox Machina 's animated "special"—which has since become a fully-fledged series spanning multiple seasons.

Originally asking for $1.5 million, the movie has brought in over $6.8 million at the time of writing. Now, this doesn't actually make it the highest-crowdfunded movie of all time by technicality —that award goes to 2025's David, which raised around $52 million, though that was achieved through asking for investors, rather than backers.

It was also based on a little book called The Bible, not a web series from 2007-2013 about World of Warcraft players. The Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit have a significant advantage when it comes to word of mouth.

"The Kickstarter is over. $6.8 million. You guys are incredible. Thank you for the support. The community. The creativity. We are so excited to make a movie and so much more for you guys," writes Felicia Day , who created the series itself. Day has since had a prolific career as an actress and the founder of Geek and Sundry, who we have to thank for the existence of Critical Role.

Which is cause for celebration! Though, I can't help but gnaw a little at my fingernails—The Guild was created originally in, quite literally, a different era, where MMOs were mysterious and inaccessible , and communities were more common. Heck, the OG series got picked up and streamed on Zune Marketplace and MSN Video. Remember those? I sure didn't.

And hey, maybe the Knights of Good going to the ren faire'll be a good laugh, but you'll either have to trade out most of the humour for jabs about how everything's on a Discord server now and high-end raids are datamined to death—or you'll have to become a little dated, only appealing to… well, people like me.

Which'll lead to three outcomes, two of which I dread: I'll be reminded of the sorry state of my favourite game genre by a bunch of actors who've aged better than me, I'll be mercilessly pandered to, or Felicia Day will successfully thread the needle and I'll have nothing to worry about. And hey, 45,500 people with $6.8 million bucks to spare aren't nearly as nervous. The Guild: Ren Faire'd plans to release sometime in 2027.

items.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion – I Spent 44 Hours in 4 Days Playing it in Bethesda's Basement
items.summary: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion was arguably the defining moment of the first months of the HD Era and a true k

others.title: Ray Chase, the voice of Cyclops in X-Men '97, has '1,000 freaking hours' in Slay the Spire and is running a 'smell build' in Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2: ' I wear perfumes and walk into battle with my fancy boy outfit'

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/22/oblivion-1787434528792.jpg

I imagine the Xbox stories I’ve been sharing on IGN recently in the run-up to the brand’s 25th anniversary probably seem a little ridiculous or even a bit crazy now – like how I got to be one of the first people to ever play through Halo 2 while playing in a storage closet at Bungie – but I promise you it was all pretty normal back then. Today I have another one of those stories for you, and it’s one of my favorite gaming memories of all time. It’s about The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion.

If you were a gamer back when the Xbox 360 first came out, you’ll remember how big a deal it was that the Xbox 360 was the first console of the “HD Era,” as the entire history of video games up to that point (at least on the console side – respect to my fellow PC gamers who’d been 1024x768’ing it for years by then). Finally we were moving from 640x480 (interlaced, to boot) to 1280x720. It sounds quaint now, but it was a huge leap at the time. The 360 had gotten off to a fast start in November of 2005 thanks to the likes of Call of Duty 2, Project Gotham Racing 3, and then a couple months later, the jaw-dropping Fight Night Round 3. But there was one game we were all anticipating far more than any other in the 360’s first months: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It was supposed to be a day-one launch title for the new Xbox, but it got delayed .

I was personally and professionally so excited for this game, as it seemed like my ultimate medieval fantasy RPG come to life. And so I’d spearheaded Official Xbox Magazine’s coverage throughout 2005; I think I made at least two trips out to Bethesda Game Studios in Maryland that year as excitement for the game and the console built. The studio had already won a lot of console-gamer fans through its 2002 original Xbox port of The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind, but this time, Oblivion was readied as a day-one Xbox 360 game, simultaneous to its PC launch. And what I had seen on those trips – translated into feature stories in OXM – had only fueled my hype even more. The stunning graphics, the incredible music, the “living” NPCs who had daily routines they’d go through whether you were around or not – it all felt like it was coalescing into something truly special.

So when it finally came time to review Oblivion, OXM was once again able to secure the exclusive review. Combined with the lead times necessitated by magazine publishing schedules, it meant that I found myself back at Bethesda in January of 2006 to review Oblivion, which shipped in March. Everyone knew it’d be a big game – Morrowind most certainly was – and so the plan was to spend four days at Bethesda and play as much as I possibly could. When I arrived at the studio, I was brought down to the basement floor, I said hello (again) to Todd Howard, and then I was escorted into a glass-walled conference room. There I had a giant TV at one end of the room, my chair and an Xbox 360 dev kit at the other end of the room, and a controller on the table. And then everyone else left.

My mission was to get as many hours under my belt as I could before heading home to write the review for the magazine. My hotel was literally next door to Bethesda’s office, so I wouldn’t even have to spend time getting to and from the studio. Food was ordered in for me, and I took short breaks and ate right in the conference room. It was just me and the archer/thief I’d created for 44 hours over four days. Yes, I spent roughly 11 hours per day living in Cyrodiil without having to think about anything else: no other work, no other responsibilities. It was amazing, and one of the best gaming experiences of my life.

I explored, I fought, I snuck, I stole, I joined the Dark Brotherhood, I closed a whole bunch of Oblivion Gates, and yes, I made sure to complete the main story questline. I even found, tamed, and rode a unicorn in the forest. The worst part of all of this was twofold: one, having to stop. And two, having to start over once the final retail copies of the game arrived. But as a testament to how incredible that game was (and thankfully still is, thanks to last year’s great remaster ), I put another 125-plus hours into it at home in March, soaking in every DLC and expansion that dropped after launch. (I gave Oblivion a 9.5 out of 10 in OXM, if you’re curious.)

The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion was arguably the defining moment of the first months of the HD Era and a true killer app for the Xbox 360 – you had to buy the console so you wouldn’t miss out on this game. And if you’ve made it this far, I’ll bet you’ve got lots of great memories of this one too. Here’s hoping that The Elder Scrolls 6 can recapture at least some of that magic.
25 Years of Xbox
For more of my memories from across a quarter-century of writing about Xbox games, check out these other stories:

Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .

items.title: Paradox commits a classic blunder and accidentally leaks its own post-apocalyptic grand strategy game
items.summary: Just a day early, so close.

content.v: As we head into big gaming week™ there are lots of studios with secret projects whirring behind the scenes, waiting to be announced at Gamescom or Opening Night Live. We now know that Paradox is one of said studios, thanks to its own forum filters.

"Paradox Forum website seems to accidentally list the unannounced game's name in the Unreleased Game filters," one eagle-eyed detective pointed out (via DualShockers ) on Reddit. In the accompanying screenshot you can see the keyword Afterworld appear beneath Unreleased Games and Prison Architect 2.
What is happening across the Paradox Universe? Find out more on Aug 25th @gamescom #gamescom #OpeningNightLive #CanYouGuessPDX👀 https://t.co/0FnSCPP0pC pic.twitter.com/2PWA9FBz1o August 21, 2026

Paradox has also been hinting at something appearing at Gamescom: "What is happening across the Paradox Universe?", a social media post reads. "Find out more on Aug 25th." And players seem to think Afterworld is set to be the big reveal.

Since then, online sleuths have been digging deeper. The Redditor who spotted the game name on the forums finally struck gold on Discord, finding the unreleased server , which had the following description: "Lead a tribe of survivors, rediscover ancient technology, manage wasteland settlements and wage wars of conquest and political struggle in Afterworld, an original post-apocalyptic survival grand strategy game." Sadly, the sleuthing stopped there: "Edit: rip they kicked me :(".

On the Paradox forums, there's a mix of speculation, a few reservations, and some disappointment that it's not the fantasy grand strategy game that a lot of folk were expecting. "To be honest: I would have liked a more fantasy based setting," one comment reads . "But ultimately the quality of a game is decided by mechanics and not by the setting."

Another forum member expressed concerns that it could go down the Fallout route, by treating "civilisation as a sort of 'one and done' endeavour and have the survivors forever picking at the corpse of the old world instead of ever making meaningful progress in building a new one."

It's worth reiterating that this is all based on one brief description, accompanied by some art, so it's a bit early to draw any conclusions. We'll likely find out more in the coming days, with Gamescom officially kicking off on Tuesday night with ONL.

items.title: 《GTA6》黑客投票结果遭篡改？国外玩家炸锅
items.summary: 据社区追踪，黑客Cyberleek在放出第10段GTA 6开发片段后，于近日开启了第11段实机内容的社区投票，候选主题分别为"海滩""裸体小镇"…

content.v: 由你来说： 投票截止前"裸体小镇"还以71%的得票率碾压全场，结果正式出炉瞬间，"沙滩"突然变成100%，另外两个选项直接归零——这反转连演都不演了，黑客Cyberleek这是把玩家当傻子？
据社区追踪，黑客Cyberleek在放出第10段GTA 6开发片段后，于近日开启了第11段实机内容的社区投票，候选主题分别为"海滩""裸体小镇"和"脱衣舞俱乐部2"。在投票进行期间，"裸体小镇"一直以绝对优势领跑，截至投票结束前数小时已获得超过56000票，占比高达71%，而"海滩"与"脱衣舞俱乐部2"分别仅有约14.7%和14.2%的支持率，三者差距悬殊。

然而当投票正式截止、结果页面刷新后，戏剧性的一幕出现了：原本遥遥领先的"裸体小镇"票数瞬间清零，得票率跌至0%；"脱衣舞俱乐部2"同样归零；唯独此前垫底的"海滩"一跃成为100%全票当选的"赢家"。如此离谱的数据反转，意味着在投票最后时刻，要么有近六万张支持"裸体小镇"的选票被全部撤回或作废，要么存在人为后台干预，直接将结果锁定为单一选项。值得注意的是，结果页面显示"延迟投票被接受"以及"投票尚未最终完成"等字样，暗示系统仍允许在截止后继续向指定地址捐赠代币，但即便如此，从71%的压倒性领先到0票的彻底消失，在正常的社区投票机制中几乎不可能发生。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242106582114.png

Reddit社区迅速炸锅，玩家纷纷晒出投票前后对比截图质疑结果真实性。有玩家直接贴出投票截止前"裸体小镇"大幅领先的截图，与最终"海滩100%"的结果形成鲜明对比，直言"这明显是个bug，裸体小镇之前明明赢了"。更多人则将矛头指向Cyberleek本人，嘲讽"他居然在操纵选举，真是太令人震惊了"，认为所谓的社区投票从头到尾就是一场闹剧。有玩家分析道，"他100%是凭着自己掌握的录像自行决定的，这太明显了——没人会花1万个代币去改变结果"。还有玩家对从71%骤降到0%的数据表示无法理解，"裸体小镇的比例怎么会降到0%？之前好像是71%"。部分玩家甚至开始互相调侃"到底哪个赢了"，在混乱的结果面前陷入迷茫，也有人无奈表示"终于有点常识了"，暗讽这场闹剧早该被揭穿。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242107067342.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242107073957.png
目前，Cyberleek尚未对这一离谱的投票反转作出任何解释。你认为这次投票结果是技术故障、人为操控，还是泄露者自导自演的一出闹剧？如果下一波泄露主题真的变成"海滩"，你还愿意继续关注这位黑客的爆料吗？

items.title: 《塞尔达时之笛RE》发售日泄露！零售商提前上架
items.summary: 任天堂尚未官宣的《塞尔达传说：时之笛》Switch 2版本，近日被瑞士零售商wog.ch提前上架。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242100589025.png
任天堂尚未官宣的《塞尔达传说：时之笛》Switch 2版本，近日被瑞士零售商wog.ch提前上架。商品页面显示，该作将于2026年12月1日正式发售，定价79.90瑞士法郎。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242100593059.png
Reddit社区r/GamingLeaksAndRumours迅速注意到这一信息。有用户指出，该零售商过去曾多次在官方公布前准确列出游戏发售日期，其中最近一次成功案例是Switch版《鬼泣5》——该作的发售日正是由这家零售商提前泄露，随后得到官方证实。
目前，任天堂方面尚未对12月1日这一日期作出任何回应。《塞尔达传说：时之笛》Switch 2版本的存在本身也尚未获得官方确认，此次零售商页面的突然上线是否为操作失误还是确有其事，仍有待观察。考虑到该零售商过往的"准确战绩"，这一消息的可信度已引发玩家社区的高度关注。

items.title: Windows将很快允许用户自己分配内存给游戏和AI
items.summary: 对于没有独立显卡的电脑来说，日常的图形处理、AI运算和系统任务只能共用一整块内存，而目前这块内存到底怎么分，完全是由Windows系统自己说了算。不过，随着苹果、高通和英伟达等科技巨头开始围绕统一内存池（这种内存池未来甚

content.v: 对于没有独立显卡的电脑来说，日常的图形处理、AI运算和系统任务只能共用一整块内存，而目前这块内存到底怎么分，完全是由Windows系统自己说了算。不过，随着苹果、高通和英伟达等科技巨头开始围绕统一内存池（这种内存池未来甚至可能高达几百GB）打造AI PC，这种内存的分配方式就显得越来越重要。
最近的一个Windows 11测试版中暗藏了一些线索，表明微软正准备放权，让用户自己来决定统一内存池里系统内存和显存的划分比例。有了这个功能，玩家在兼顾打游戏和跑AI任务时就能更加得心应手，尤其是在英伟达RTX Spark平台等即将问世的统一内存设备上。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260824/1787577065_979580.webp
8月17日发布的Windows 11版本29648.1000带来了一个名为“智能分配”的新功能，但在微软的更新日志里却对它只字未提。知名Windows爆料人@phantomofearth向媒体Windows Latest证实，该版本的代码中确实提到了为加速器、图形处理和AI预留专用内存。
这意味着用户可以手动把一部分统一内存专门划给游戏和吃配置的AI应用，这部分被圈出来的内存，其他任何程序都绝对无法占用。
其实之前在英伟达的官方文档里也出现过类似的说法。如果这个功能最终向公众开放，它将彻底颠覆大家在统一内存芯片上调优性能的习惯。
一直以来，统一内存主要用在Mac、部分笔记本电脑、PC掌机以及其他采用核显而不是独显的系统上。
根据处理任务的不同，与自带专属显存的独立显卡相比，这类系统在性能表现上会有很大的差异。虽然重度的图形任务在显存不够用时可以去借用系统内存，但这种做法往往会导致性能大幅缩水。
运行本地AI模型需要海量的高速内存，因此原本主要用来打游戏的高端显卡，现在成了跑AI的香饽饽。与此同时，专门为本地AI模型打造的电脑，其统一内存的容量也越来越大。随着本地AI的火爆，哪怕是配备了24GB甚至更大统一内存的Mac也常常面临内存吃紧的窘境，而微软和英伟达给出的应对方案，就是最高能提供128GB超大内存的RTX Spark设备。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260824/1787577072_115841_jpg_r.jpg
英伟达之所以能在GPU领域称霸，靠的可不仅仅是硬件芯片，其强大的软件生态同样功不可没。CUDA编程、DLSS超分辨率、Reflex降延迟技术以及整个RTX全家桶，都成了比纯拼硬件更有吸引力的核心卖点。如今，英伟达把这套软件体系原封不动地搬到了核显领域，这让RTX Spark天生就比AMD、高通和英特尔更有优势，毕竟在AI和游戏性能的软件生态上，这三家目前还远不是英伟达的对手。
当初发布RTX Spark芯片时，英伟达就曾放出豪言，称其支持的寻址内存容量超过了自家任何一款GPU。因为有了只能分配这项功能，用户就可以把这128GB庞大内存池中的一大块直接分配给图形和AI任务。这样一来，RTX Spark的GPU最终能调用的内存，甚至比顶级显卡RTX 5090那32GB的独立显存还要多得多。
当然了，这种基于LPDDR5x的共享内存池在速度上肯定没法和RTX 5090的GDDR7相提并论，所以它赢在容量够大，而不是速度够快。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Final Fantasy Resonance Has More Going For It Than Just Its Impressive Cast
items.summary: Ahead of its release in October, Square Enix has dropped several new details about Final Fantasy Resonance , i

content.v: Ahead of its release in October, Square Enix has dropped several new details about Final Fantasy Resonance , its HD-2D reimagining of the mobile game Final Fantasy: Brave Exvius. Based on the first season of Brave Exvius, here's a closer look at the game's world, characters, gameplay, vision systems, and completionist content.
Empires strike back
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Zoldaad.jpg?w=636

Two of the regions that players can explore include the powerful military nation of Zoldaad and the city of mages known as Mysidia. Just like in Brave Exvius, Zoldaad appears to be on the march as the home of the fabled Fire Crystal, and has secretly been building up a fleet of airships and mass-producing magitek as it expands its borders into neighboring countries. Considered to be a legend, the advanced magical civilization of Mysidia is home to some of the strongest magic-wielders in the world and is said to also house the Ice Crystal.
Characters
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Sakura.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/VeritasoftheEarth.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/VeritasoftheFlame.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/VeritasoftheLight.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Jake.jpg

Previous trailers have already shown us the main cast of Final Fantasy Resonance--Rain, Laswell, Fina, Jake, and Lid--and if you played the mobile game, you can also expect to see a few more familiar faces like the Mysidian sage Sakura. Opposing the heroes are the Sworn Six of Paladia, the Veritas. Each Veritas represents an element, and their roster includes the brutish Veritas of Flame, the honorable Veritas of Earth, and the volatile Veritas of Light.
Gameplay
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/EN22-05.jpg?w=636

At its core, Final Fantasy Resonance is an old-school turn-based RPG, full of hard-hitting Limit Break attacks and chances to strategically outmaneuver enemies. One of the big draws in the game are the Visions of legendary Final Fantasy heroes , who can fight alongside Rain and his companions when they're summoned. Players may use the magic and abilities of Visions in combat, and the stronger your bond with them grows, the more abilities you'll unlock for these legends.

Staggering all enemies in one turn will even allow you to trigger a Resonance with a vision, resulting in them performing an exceptionally devastating attack--while your eyes get treated to a slick piece of CG animation. You can even make your Visions stronger, but there's a catch: You'll need magicite to grant them stronger abilities, but because the material is exceedingly rare, you'll have to choose which Vision you strengthen. Some of the Visions also include original characters that were first introduced in Brave Exvius:
As mentioned above, heroes from previous Final Fantasy games can also be recruited to your party:
Espers
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/EN27-02.jpg?w=636

For some extra firepower, you can also summon Espers. These powerful beings will join your battle for three turns, and once the timer is up, they'll drop a devastating attack before they vanish. The cuddly Carbuncle will cast Reflect magic on your party, the sea serpent Leviathan will deal water damage to enemies with a Tsunami, the armor-clad Odin can dish out a non-elemental attack that might instakill some enemies, and the mighty dragon Bahamut unleashes his signature Megaflare assault on foes.
Completionist content
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/EN24-02.jpg?w=636

Anyone looking to 100% Final Fantasy Resonance will want to make certain their party is ready to fight. Square Enix is teasing a battle with the mysterious bladesman Gilgamesh, and if you're feeling really confident, you can even challenge Ultima Weapon. A boss battle that has cropped up in several Final Fantasy games over the decades, Ultima Weapon demands perfect preparation, or you can expect your challenge to be over in just a few short turns.
Final Fantasy Resonance launches for PC and consoles on October 22.

items.title: 黑幕？GTA6泄露投票出炉：高跟鞋、裸体小镇战败
items.summary: 据社区追踪，黑客Cyberleek在放出第10段《GTA 6》开发片段后，于近日开启了第11段实机内容的社区投票，候选主题分别为"海滩""裸体小…

content.v: 据社区追踪，黑客Cyberleek在放出第10段《GTA 6》开发片段后，于近日开启了第11段实机内容的社区投票，候选主题分别为"海滩""裸体小镇"和"脱衣舞俱乐部2"。在投票进行期间，"裸体小镇"一直以绝对优势领跑，截至投票结束前数小时已获得超过56000票，占比高达71%，而"海滩"与"脱衣舞俱乐部2"分别仅有约14.7%和14.2%的支持率，三者差距悬殊。
然而当投票正式截止、结果页面刷新后，戏剧性的一幕出现了：原本遥遥领先的"裸体小镇"票数瞬间清零，得票率跌至0%；"脱衣舞俱乐部2"同样归零；唯独此前垫底的"海滩"一跃成为100%全票当选的"赢家"。如此离谱的数据反转，意味着在投票最后时刻，要么有近六万张支持"裸体小镇"的选票被全部撤回或作废，要么存在人为后台干预，直接将结果锁定为单一选项。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242055581139.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242055585628.png
值得注意的是，结果页面显示"延迟投票被接受"以及"投票尚未最终完成"等字样，暗示系统仍允许在截止后继续向指定地址捐赠代币。但即便如此，从71%的压倒性领先到0票的彻底消失，在正常的社区投票机制中几乎不可能发生。
目前，Cyberleek尚未对这一离谱的投票反转作出任何解释。你认为这次投票结果是技术故障、人为操控，还是泄露者自导自演的一出闹剧？如果下一波泄露主题真的变成"海滩"，你还愿意继续关注这位黑客的爆料吗？

items.title: 经典18禁《遗作》官宣重制！新增成人内容
items.summary: 经典成人逃脱游戏《遗作》（Isaku）即将迎来重制。负责经典视觉小说重制的FG Remake于8月21日宣布，该作将在时隔约30年后重新推出。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242052112972.png
经典成人逃脱游戏《遗作》（Isaku）即将迎来重制。负责经典视觉小说重制的FG Remake于8月21日宣布，该作将在时隔约30年后重新推出。
《遗作》原版由现已解散的视觉小说厂商Elf开发，于1995年登陆PC-9801平台。此次重制版将支持Windows，并针对现代平台进行全面升级。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242052378962.png
重制版由原作画师上田メタヲ重新绘制角色立绘与CG，同时加入Full HD支持、全新的UI以及新增成人向内容。游戏仍然保留原作的核心逃脱玩法。
故事讲述高中生木暮健太收到暗恋对象的情书，被邀请前往学校旧校舍顶层。抵达后，他发现包括暗恋对象在内的数名学生以及一名教师同样被召集至此。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242052476371.png
然而众人很快发现校舍已经被封锁，幕后黑手则是学校的管理员伊作佐藤。玩家需要在封闭的校园中寻找逃生方法，并面对各种机关与陷阱。
游戏玩法以解谜、寻找钥匙以及躲避陷阱为主。玩家在与其他被困人员交流时做出的不同选择，也可能影响其他角色最终是成功逃脱还是遭遇危险。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/24/small_202608242052539348.png
据官方介绍，《遗作》被视为日本早期“鬼畜系”成人游戏代表作品之一，此次重制版依旧保留成人向内容，其中部分内容以游戏内录像带的形式呈现。
《遗作》重制版预计于12月25日正式发售，目前仅支持日语。游戏将推出实体版和数字豪华版，后者还将附带一份兼容Windows 11的原版《遗作》。
值得一提的是，原版距离今天已经过去了约30年，此次重制也让这款曾经登陆PC-9801平台的老作品重新回到了现代PC玩家面前。

items.title: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》B测第一轮 数据不是那么亮眼
items.summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》于8月22日开启了抢先体验BETA测试，这是第一轮测试，主要面向预购玩家，8月26日结束。虽然动视尚未公布具体数据，但我们可以查看其在Steam平台上的表现，并将其与其他近期《使命召唤》系列Bet

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》于8月22日开启了抢先体验BETA测试，这是第一轮测试，主要面向预购玩家，8月26日结束。虽然动视尚未公布具体数据，但我们可以查看其在Steam平台上的表现，并将其与其他近期《使命召唤》系列Beta测试，以及竞争对手系列的Beta测试进行比较。
目前测试主要面向预购游戏的玩家，不过也可以通过内容创作者、社交媒体赠送活动或其他渠道获得免费测试码。这一点值得注意，因为这实际上限制了测试的覆盖范围，也意味着下周末公开测试阶段开始时，参与人数可能会更多。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260824/1787574985_323386.webp
在Steam平台上，《使命召唤：现代战争4》B测第一轮最高同时在线玩家人数达到了11万5145人。首日（上周六）同时在线人数开局强劲，之后逐日下降。值得注意的是，《使命召唤：现代战争4》测试版在Steam平台上拥有独立的页面，并非隶属于《使命召唤》APP。
《使命召唤：现代战争4》BETA测试在Steam上当前在线只有3万人，24小时峰值4.6万人，这意味着自开测以来，《现代战争4》已经“流失”了超过七成玩家。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260824/1787575096_752780_jpg_r.jpg
完整版游戏可能仍然存在于该APP应用程序下，这将使追踪其表现变得更加困难，因为《使命召唤》应用程序还包含免费游玩的《战区》以及过去几年的几款游戏。
对比而言，《现代战争2》测试版在2022年创下了16万8330名玩家同时在线的纪录。随着下一轮《现代战争4》测试版加入战区模式试玩、新模式和新地图，我们或许能够看到这一纪录被追平甚至打破。
不过《现代战争4》肯定比去年的《使命召唤：黑色行动7》测试版要好得多，后者当时Steam上的最高同时在线玩家人数只有10万人。
一年前，动视暴雪曾表示《使命召唤：黑色行动6》的测试版是该系列历史上规模最大的一次，但并未透露具体数字。
然而，和《战地6》相比，《使命召唤》的数据就很难看了。 《战地6》的公开测试版在Steam上创下52.1万的惊人峰值表现。
需要注意的是，Steam数据只能反映部分情况。虽然其数据与其他平台基本一致，但主机平台的数据可能更好。事实上，即使在PC端，也有部分玩家使用战网版本或微软商城版本。
自BETA测试版上线以来，IW一直在进行更新，分别在周六和周日发布了一个大型补丁。这些补丁新增了一张地图、一种游戏模式和一个新的游戏列表。此外，他们还对测试版中表现最佳的两款武器进行了平衡性调整，并修改了其中一张地图的视野范围。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 7 Magic: The Gathering Crossovers We Want for Universes Beyond in 2027 and Beyond
items.summary: Following Hasbro's tease of more "fantasy-adjacent" Magic: The Gathering Universes Beyond sets for 2027, here

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mtg-universes-beyond-20276-predictions-2-1787570796222.png

Magic: The Gathering’s 2027 lineup is taking shape, with half of the six sets revealed. From a return to Kamigawa to afrofantasy and underwater adventures, we’re just waiting for our first look at Universes Beyond sets to fill out the calendar.
We’ll likely get our first look at MagicCon Atlanta in November, but for now, there’s no harm in some fun predictions on what could be coming up next.
What We Know So Far
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mtg-universes-beyond-2027-1787573780121.png

In a recent quarterly earnings report , Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks noted feedback on recent Universes Beyond sets, which have run the gamut from two trips to Middle-Earth, just as many visits to New York City, every single Final Fantasy, and, soon, Star Trek.
“The one thing I'll say on the Universes Beyond partners that we have next year is they'll probably be a bit more fantasy-adjacent," he explained."
"And I don't think any of them will take place in New York City because we definitely have gotten that feedback from some fans."

We know there will be three new Universes Beyond sets, with one in April, one in August, and one in November. So, there are a lot of potential crossovers that would be fun for Magic: The Gathering, but the idea of refocusing on fantasy IP certainly is interesting.
Here are some that make some sense, all of which you can consider part of our Universes Beyond wishlist for 2027. Let's take a look.
The Legend of Zelda
Ooo boy, this would be big. Hasbro has already partnered with Nintendo to make The Legend of Zelda toys , but could that extend to Magic, too?
The core identity of a grand, fantasy adventure is a great fit, and the Final Fantasy set showed that Magic can take an IP that covers multiple stories, realities, and timelines and do each justice.

A Master Sword you can equip to Link, Bokoblin creatures to amass, and multiple powerful versions of Ganon make this an obvious fit. We've got the live-action Zelda film coming up soon as well, so this could be another big move for the series... if Nintendo allows it.
The Witcher

Sticking with fantasy video games, albeit much dirtier, grim, and morally gray ones, The Witcher series will return in the coming years with a fourth entry . There’s an absolute ton to pull from already, and Wizards of the Coast could even pick from the book series as well if its so inclined.

The main cast of characters would be easy to build a focus around, but there’s also such a deep bestiary that you can then add the griffin, the leshen, and much, much more. Saga cards based on iconic quests like The Bloody Baron would also be a fun way to relive some of Geralt’s most famous adventures.

Let's not forget that CD Projekt Red has also already dabbled in the card game space with Gwent: The Witcher Card Game , so there's also a bunch of fun concepts Wizards could riff from, and plenty of brilliant artists to call upon again if needed.
Mystical Marvel
Yes, OK, it’s hardly swords and sorcery, but we know more Marvel sets are coming, so why not make it more about spellcraft than spandex, right?

Give us a Marvel’s "Midnight Suns" set that incorporates the likes of Blade and Doctor Strange, or take us to Asgard for some cardboard gods. It’s fantasy through the lens of Marvel, sure, but it’d be a nice break from the webslingers and the shield-wielders of the IP.
Warhammer: Age of Sigmar
One of my most treasured Magic items is a set of all four Commander decks from the Warhammer 40,000 run in 2022. They’re annoyingly expensive now , but play brilliantly.

I bring this up because the other side of the coin is a "Warhammer: Age of Sigmar" set of Commander Decks (or maybe more) that leans into the Games Workshop brand’s more high-fantasy setting that includes existing Magic archetypes like duardin (dwarves), aelves (elves), and orruks (orks) among others.
Look, I’d be happy with more 40K races, too — give us the T’au, Astra Militarum, and Adeptus Mechanicus. Age of Sigmar just makes sense to explore, as well.
Game of Thrones
Despite the TV show’s controversial ending, Game of Thrones remains an IP that’ll be pulling in cash as long as George R.R. Martin has yet to finish the book series .

Game of Thrones (or A Song of Ice and Fire ) now has multiple spinoffs, comic books, video games, and even a standalone card game itself from Fantasy Flight Games , so why not add a Magic: The Gathering set into the mix as well?

It could include content from the prequels like Fire and Blood (and riffing on House of the Dragon ), as well as deeper cuts like Lady Stoneheart... Or it could just be reskinned Tarkir: Dragonstorm with its various factions and big, fire-breathing creatures.
Either way, this could be the perfect crossover waiting to happen.
FromSoftware/Elden Ring
This has been mooted for years to the point where I feel we’re at least going to get a Secret Lair out of it, but a FromSoft collaboration would be massive.

Consider the medieval fantasy vibes that run deep from Demon’s Souls and Dark Souls , to Elden Ring . The sheer volume of fantastic bosses would make for a great character list, like Ornstein and Smough, Knight Artorias, Nameless King, and more.

Then there’s Bloodborne to consider as well, packed with memorable moments and such a powerful cosmic-horror, gothic vibe that stands alone from the rest of the studio’s creations. In all honestly it probably deserves a set on its own, even if we do have that animated film to look forward to .

Still, it feels as though Elden Ring is perhaps the most likely to get its own set. The game sold by the bucketload , has a live-action Hollywood film coming soon, and is likely many people’s first introduction to FromSoft’s unique brand of mechanical masochism. Yeah, I can see this happening, for sure.
Blizzard Entertainment
Wizards of the Coast has already confirmed a Dungeons & Dragons expansion based on World of Warcraft , so it’s not too much of a jump to suggest its massively successful MMO could come to Magic, too.

Still, that could cause some issues with the likes of Hearthstone butting up against Magic Arena, so why not something a little different? While I’d be very pleased to see an Overwatch Secret Lair drop with some of the hero shooter’s iconic heroes, I reckon we’ve got more chance of a full set for Diablo .

The loot-filled title is all about demons and hellfire, and that’s something Magic already has in spades. Factor in equipment cards based on Mythic items, and you’ve got a neat Voltron deck idea as you build your class-specific Commander in fun ways.
Those are some of our predictions, but what are you expecting? Let us know in the comments!

Lloyd Coombes is an experienced freelancer in tech, gaming and fitness seen at Polygon, Eurogamer, Macworld, TechRadar and many more. He's a big fan of Magic: The Gathering and other collectible card games, much to his wife's dismay.

items.title: There's a looming GPU supply crisis, which means prices are likely to get a whole lot worse. And it's not just because of memory
items.summary: One of the biggest manufacturers of graphics cards has noted in its results that the second half of this year

content.v: A couple weeks back I noted that I'd been tracking GPU prices on an almost weekly basis for a year now, and that things have never been worse . Well, PC Partner—one of the biggest manufacturers of graphics cards you've probably never heard of—suggests it's going to get even worse. And probably quickly.

PC Partner makes a ton of graphics cards for its consumer facing brands Zotac, Inno3D, and Manli. I've visited one of its main factories in Dongguan, China, and it's production lines are big. So when Singaporean outlet, The Straits Times , notes the company as saying that the supply of graphics cards is going to get real tight in the coming months it's worth listening.

And the worst part about it is that apparently it's going to be the entry level cards that will be the most adversely affected. With severe shortages comes increased prices, and while Nvidia cards with VRAM capacities of 8 GB haven't had the spiking price tags of their more heavily memory'd cousins, it looks like it won't be long before they do.

Benchlife, reporting on the PC Partner announcement , has itself confirmed that supply of Nvidia's RTX Blackwell GPUs in the third quarter of this year is below the second quarter, and that supply at the end of the year will be even lower than that. It also notes that this isn't purely down to the constrained supply of GPUs and memory owing to the demands of the data centre elites, but that other parts of the graphics card manufacturing process—such as PCBs and power componentry—are also suffering from long lead times compared with last year.

Given that Nvidia RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB and RTX 5070 graphics cards are both now batting around the $800 mark, it's mighty concerning that the more affordable end of the GPU spectrum look set to get slammed with higher prices, too. The doom disciple in me fears for a world where an RTX 5050 costs $500.
Though it can only cost $500 if someone is willing to pay that and surely, surely no-one would. Would they?

But it's not just going to be Nvidia cards though. It has been GeForce GPUs which have been affected more by the most recent price spike (though RX 9000 series cards have also had their fair share of price increases immediately after launch), but PC Partner is also the contract manufacturer of Sapphire GPUs, one of AMD's biggest graphics card makers, so I don't doubt it was talking to those cards, too. Especially if part of the supply constraints are around other components all GPUs need to live.
And if AMD cards get priced out of the reach of us mere PC gaming mortals, then there will be no alternatives for us.

items.title: The Blood Of Dawnwalker Devs Heard Your 60fps Requests And Have Good News For Console Players
items.summary: If you wanted to play The Blood of Dawnwalker at 60fps, you'd originally need to get the PC version and hope y

content.v: If you wanted to play The Blood of Dawnwalker at 60fps, you'd originally need to get the PC version and hope your rig was up to scratch . Developer Rebel Wolves didn't initially list a 60fps mode for Xbox Series X, PS5, and PS5 Pro when it recently released a quick look at the graphical modes for those consoles, but the developer says it will now be added via a day-one patch when the game launches in September.

"Performance mode was already in the works, but it was still being tested. We simply weren’t ready to promise it yet," Rebel Wolves wrote on its The Blood of Dawnwalker X account. "We heard your feedback. It was clear how much this mattered to many of you, so we focused on finishing the next round of tests. Those results gave us the confidence we needed to confirm Performance Mode for Day one."

The Blood of Dawnwalker will have three modes to choose from on Xbox Series X, PS5, and PS5 Pro: Performance targets 60fps, Balanced targets 40fps, and Quality targets 30fps. Xbox Series S owners are only getting one mode, which targets 30fps on the lower-spec hardware. Rebel Wolves hasn't detailed the major differences between the modes either, but typically, Performance mode prioritizes a higher, smoother frame rate while cutting back on fancier lighting effects, simpler particle effects, and less detail compared to Quality mode. Balanced mode attempts to have the best of both worlds while targeting 40fps, while the PS5 Pro has proven to be a 4K 60fps powerhouse after the rollout of an upgraded PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution earlier this year.

Out on September 3, The Blood of Dawnwalker is the debut game from Rebel Wolves, a studio that features several former Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077 developers in its roster, including The Witcher 3 game director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz. Set in a dark medieval world full of vampires and grim fantasy, players will have to grapple with the consequences of their actions as they build up power for a final showdown against the vampire lord Brencis.

"Whether you're talking to your best friend, working to bandage an injured comrade, or battling opponents to save your father's life, when the hunger takes hold, your actions may suddenly be out of your control. Dawnwalker is a game all about making you live with the consequences," Phil Hornshaw wrote in GameSpot's The Blood of Dawnwalker preview .

items.title: PS5's Best-Selling Games List Fixed After Ordering Issue Over Weekend
items.summary: Not a big deal for Sony's engineers. Good news for the makers of 007 First Light and 1000xRESIST – both games

content.v: Last week, the Communications Workers of America and the Bethesda Game Studios OneBGS union took part in the Save Our Devs rally across the United States and Canada (and on Twitch ) "to call out layoffs and corporate greed across the industry and to demand fair first contracts across Microsoft’s gaming studios." Speaking to Kotaku , Bethesda artist Alex Nguyen talked about how things changed after Bethesda was acquired by the tech giant.

"Since we’ve been under Microsoft… it feels like something has changed. We didn’t have layoffs before, and now all of a sudden we have yearly layoffs," he told Kotaku, saying teams were feeling the effects of cuts which eroded institutional knowledge. “If only five people knew how this thing worked and you let all five of them go, that’s a morale killer because it’s like we already knew this, and now we have to learn it again.”

According to that article, Nguyen pointed out that fixer-uppers like Fallout 76 and Elder Scrolls Online don't get a chance to bloom into successful fan favorites without sufficient labor and time. He also noted that there used to be a shared sense of long-term commitment among the staff at Zenimax and Bethesda—a commitment being smothered by Microsoft's current corporate tactics.

“That’s why a lot of people had such a long tenure here," Nguyen told Kotaku. "And they were like, ‘yeah, this is the place I’m gonna retire at,’ or ‘this is the place where I’m gonna finish out,’ or ‘I love being here because I want to stay in the industry for a long time.’ That was basically one of the benefits of being at Bethesda or a Zenimax studio in general.”

Last year, ex-Xbox head Phil Spencer said that " nurturing and protecting creative teams that want to go take risks " was of the utmost importance less than two years after Xbox's acquisition of Blizzard called for 1,900 layoffs . Current Xbox head Asha Sharma has sung a similar tune so far, suggesting that Xbox ought to be entertaining over a billion people each day while also announcing the "reset" necessitating 3,200 job cuts in the very same blog post . It's plain to see why workers might balk at conditions that continue to raise the bar for achievement while more and more developers lose their livelihoods.

content.v: 此前华硕就已发布了ROG 雷切2 PRO（ROG Raikiri II PRO PC Controller），这是一款用于PC的游戏手柄，支持三模连接。目前新产品已登陆电商平台，并开启了预约抢购，显示价格为1399元，首发价格为1299元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260824/1787572693_865690_jpg_r.jpg
ROG 雷切2 PRO支持蓝牙、2.4GHz无线和有线三模连接，可无线连接Xbox主机。其搭载了ROG SpeedNova无线技术，在2.4GHz无线和有线状态下都支持8000Hz回报率，有效降低延迟，操作快速响应。手柄的续航时间最长超过了79个小时，随行包还支持包内充电，满足了玩家长时间使用的需求。华硕还附送了多种精美配件，包括充电底座和摇杆帽等。

手柄带有全彩面板，让玩家可以直接掌控核心设置，包括游戏配置文件、重新映射按键、自定义RGB灯效，并惊喜调节震动强度，以完美匹配自身游戏风格。玩家还可以在短行程微动扳机和长行程TMR扳机之间切换，以适应不同游戏的需求。同时背键、肩键、十字键和XYAB键均为微动按键设计，提供了超低延迟响应，带来游戏中的竞争优势，触发行程相比传统硅胶按键缩短50%，触发力度也减轻50%，按键寿命也会更长，高达200万次。
此外，手柄还支持AuraSync神光同步，还有奥创极速移动版与网页版。

items.title: Proposed class action lawsuit against Logitech demands money to be given back to customers after $61 million US tariff refund
items.summary: The filings claim that Logitech was 'enriched twice over at its customers’ expense.'

content.v: A proposed class action lawsuit against Logitech is attempting to recover funds that were allegedly "extracted from American consumers" as a result of the Trump administration's tariffs.

The complaint [PDF] is being led by a construction company, SJK Development, and a California resident, both of whom say they bought Logitech mice at higher, tariff-affected prices. It was filed with the US District Court for the Northern District of California, San Jose Division last week (via Ars Technica ).

"This case is an example of a large multinational corporation and its US subsidiary taking advantage of its customers who rely on the integrity of manufacturers to sell products to customers in good faith," the complaint alleges.

"[The defendant] refused to be honest with their customers by raising prices across their product catalog to allegedly account for costs due to tariffs and then failed to return tariff proceeds when the US Supreme Court declared those tariffs unlawful."

While Logitech did not publicly announce price hikes, the complaint makes mention of the company's executives discussing higher prices and profits in regards to offsetting tariffs in its subsequent earnings calls.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cguqfDdXPCcKaAeJw7Vf6R.jpg

"The company’s CFO, Mr. Anversa, attributed the company’s expanded gross margins—up approximately 130 basis points year-over-year in the fourth quarter—in part to Logitech’s United States subsidiary’s pricing actions executed in April 2025." the filing says.
"Mr. Anversa stated that those pricing actions, together with favorable currency movements, more than offset tariffs and promotions."

The Trump administration's IEEPA tariffs were ruled against by the US Supreme Court in February of this year, after it found that the US president did not have the authority to impose them. Since then, Logitech has received a sum of $61 million as part of the refund process. The lawsuit is aiming for a judgement which would force Logitech to give customers a share of the proceeds.

"Logitech has been—and absent relief will continue to be— enriched twice over at its customers’ expense," the filing continues. "Once by the tariff-justified overcharges collected from Plaintiffs and the Class, and again by the government’s refund, with interest, of the very duties those overcharges were represented to cover."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/z6wAeHCH6TPQAdrXEuVNtT.jpg

Several other tech companies, including Nintendo , Sony, and Microsoft, have been on the receiving end of similar legal actions related to tariff refunds . Earlier this month, PC cooling company Arctic announced that it would be rolling back prices on its components for US customers , after receiving a refund of its own.

I have reached out to Logitech for comment, and will update this article if any is received. In the meantime, however, I doubt this will be the last proposed class action suit regarding tariff-inflated pricing. Whatever the outcomes, it'll likely be some time before any major resolution comes to pass.

items.title: Former Rockstar Dev Calls GTA 6 Leaks 'A Nothing Burger,' Insists Hot Coffee Was Much, Much Worse
items.summary: As Take-Two works to identify the person or group behind the GTA 6 'CyberLeek' account, one former Rockstar de

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/18/jason-and-lucia-03-landscape-1781798123709.jpg

As Take-Two works to identify the person or group behind the GTA 6 'CyberLeek' account, one former Rockstar developer has insisted the recent spate of gameplay leaks will have little impact on the success of the game itself.

CyberLeek has released 10 GTA 6 gameplay videos and an image of the full map in the space of just six days , sparking a manhunt for the people responsible. Rockstar parent company Take-Two has subpoenaed Microsoft, Discord, and even X / Twitter, but the leaker appears undeterred, and is even running a crypto-fueled poll to determine which video to release next.
All this just a week before Netflix’s timed-exclusive reveal of GTA 6, which is set to fully unveil the game officially for the first time.

From a Take-Two and Rockstar perspective, significant damage is being done. According to Bloomberg , Rockstar still doesn’t know how these leaks happened, nor who is behind them. And while there are no plans to shift this week’s big Netflix reveal, Bloomberg reported that there is frustration and anger internally at recent events, with management sending morale-boosting emails to staff.

Former Rockstar Games technical director Obbe Vermeij, however, downplayed the damage caused by the leaks. Vermeij, who worked at Rockstar North from 1995 to 2009, took to social media to say the Hot Coffee scandal was much more damaging than these GTA 6 leaks.
“Calm down everybody. The leaks are a nothing burger,” Vermeij began.
“As a marketing strategy R* is trying to keep the game under wraps longer than other publishers. All that has happened is that some footage has escaped. Slightly ahead of the Netflix thing next week.
“90% of future players don’t spend their time on the internet looking for video snippets. They don’t have the time and don’t want spoilers.

“I imagine the teams are a little annoyed about it but not more than that. I was there during Hot Coffee. It was a nightmare for management (R*NewYork) but didn’t affect us (R*North) much. The current leaks are far less consequential than HC was.
“It looks like GTA 6 will be phenomenal and sell for the next 15 years or so. The leaks are just a tiny blip.”

The Hot Coffee scandal was a 2005 controversy involving a hidden, sexually explicit mini-game inside Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. Modders discovered that unfinished code left on game discs allowed players to unlock a crude, interactive sex scene, leading to political outrage, a temporary "Adults Only" rating, and multimillion-dollar settlements for Rockstar Games.

“No, it really hurt,” Vermeij said of Hot Coffee. “The game had to be withdrawn from stores in the USA. It could only be sold as 18+ until the new version was ready. It is estimated to have cost $50 million which was a lot of money for R*/T2 at the time.”
Speaking to Lex Fridman in October last year , Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser said the company “nearly imploded several times due to Hot Coffee,” adding: “It was extremely tough.”

There is growing concern that CyberLeek may spoil the GTA 6 story by releasing plot-critical cutscenes. So far, that hasn’t happened, but even if it did, Vermeij downplayed the impact. “That would suck but people will still play it,” he said.

There is also speculation that CyberLeek has a working build of GTA 6, based on some of the gameplay shown in the leaks. “If that is the case it probably only runs on a devkit,” Vermeij insisted. “Devkits have more memory. There probably isn't a build in existence that would run on a retail PS5 at the moment.”

GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, setting records for sales and revenue. As Vermeij says, the gameplay leaks are unlikely to threaten the success of the game's November launch. But they remain part of what is a significant security breach for Take-Two and Rockstar, one that will no doubt affect the morale of staff who have spent years building the game. They also potentially dampen the impact of the timed-exclusive reveal on Netflix, which I imagine isn't thrilled by what's going on.
Neither Take-Two nor Rockstar has issued a statement on the GTA 6 leaks. IGN has asked for comment.
Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

items.summary: I knew all this showboating would bite us in the butt one day.

others.title: Here's Your Best Look At Stellar Blade For Switch 2

content.v: Last week, we covered the very strange occurrence of a bug in the latest Windows update . Yes, a bug in a Windows update, say it isn't so. Unfortunately, this one does incur our wrath of gamers more than most because it leads to some games becoming unresponsive. Games like Arc Raiders, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, and The Finals. But we might have to look at our obsession with RGB lighting

When the issue first came to light, shortly after the release of KB5121003, the developer of two of those games came out with a theory. Embark Studios chalked the crashes up to a single driver, inpoutx64.sys, and noted you could disable the troublesome file through the Command Prompt.

As it turns out, that was spot on. Microsoft also thinks that inpoutx64.sys is the problem . Or, at the very least, something doesn't quite gel between inpoutx64.sys, the affected games, and the latest Windows update.

The KB5121003 update is seemingly the catalyst of the whole affair. Microsoft downplays it slightly in the wording of its ongoing investigation: "We are presently working to understand the relationship between these RGB components and the games which trigger this issue. We will provide an update when more information is available."
Anyways, Microsoft also notes what it currently believes is the actual cause of the issue, and it's pinning it mostly on RGB lighting.

"Ongoing investigation indicates that this issue is related to peripherals or internal device components which have RGB lighting features. Such devices may install drivers or code components with file names similar to inpoutx64. In systems where these drivers are found, the issue is then triggered by launching certain games."

Microsoft offers a way to disable the driver via the registry. There's a non-zero chance of messing up your entire PC when diving into the registry, so just be vigilant as you make any changes. Microsoft even recommends backing up the whole thing should anything go wrong.

As Microsoft notes, this may disable some RGB lighting features or mess with the software used to control them. So, while the company tries to figure out what exactly is causing an issue between the games, driver, and update, those affected may have to decide between playing games or their PC looking pretty. Tough call—you could also just rollback your PC to a previous Windows update and wait for a proper fix.

items.title: Twitch hit with class-action lawsuit over Amazon AI training: 'Twitch sent no email, displayed no pop-up notification, and made no announcement'
items.summary: The system was opt-out because "nobody would opt in," admitted Twitch's chief product officer.

content.v: In yet another unpleasant move in our AI hellscape, Amazon was caught training its generative AI using Twitch stream content earlier this month—a particularly brazen strategy, especially given Twitch's chief product officer admitted that the data collection was opt-out because "nobody would opt in." Hmm, I wonder why!

Anyway, despite attempts to insist that Twitch wasn't doing this, Amazon was —a distinction which pretty much doesn't matter, as Amazon owns Twitch, and even if it didn't, Twitch still would have been permitting this—the streaming platform's caught a ton of flak for trying to slide this one under the table.

Including, per Courthouse News, a class-action lawsuit. Plaintiff Warren Pandiscia, who has around 1,000 followers on the site, claims that "because Amazon AI products are commercialized, Amazon had an overwhelming incentive to acquire training data on an unprecedented scale.
"Rather than negotiate for lawful licenses or seek permission, defendants accessed the Twitch streams and videos to utilize them as a massive dataset necessary to fuel Amazon's AI products."

The full complaint , filed in California, goes on to state: "Defendants' actions were not only unlawful, but an unconscionable attack on the community of content creators whose content is used to fuel the multitrillion-dollar generative AI industry without any compensation."

The complaint also goes on to note that, per Twitch's documentation, a streamer chatting on someone else's stream might have their voice used to train generative AI despite opting out themselves, as whether or not Amazon can scrape your voice is entirely dependent on the host streamer's settings.
"By design, Defendants never obtain—and their systems are incapable of obtaining—the consent of all parties to the communications they capture," the lawsuit argues.

It also accuses Twitch and Amazon of burying the lede on giving proper notice about the feature: "Twitch sent no email, displayed no pop-up notification, and made no announcement before enabling the setting for every account. The setting was instead discovered by a reporter, Zach Bussey."

Whether or not the lawsuit will gain any steam remains to be seen. It's unfortunate, but Amazon is a giant company and might have enough sway to sweep this under the rug—and given its love affair with the technology , it's unlikely to leave Twitch, a goldmine of training data (if you don't give a crap about the people who made it that way) alone. Unless the prophesied AI bubble actually pops , that is.

items.title: 《骤影·绯月杀》将于8月25日开启限时七日测试
items.summary: 由来自杭州星汉明空 天命玄鸟游戏工作室 开发的国产非对称竞技游戏 《骤影·绯月杀》 ，将于 8月25日到8月31日 ，迎来 为期七天 的首次公开测试。与此同时，游戏正式官宣定档9.25中秋发售。 I人E人，都能感受乐趣

content.v: 由来自杭州星汉明空天命玄鸟游戏工作室开发的国产非对称竞技游戏《骤影·绯月杀》，将于8月25日到8月31日，迎来为期七天的首次公开测试。与此同时，游戏正式官宣定档9.25中秋发售。
https://image.gcores.com/e9a15ecad01ecb29504b91f41fe43636-1280-720.png
I人E人，都能感受乐趣
《骤影·绯月杀》本质上是一款融合身份推理与快节奏战斗的奇幻狼人杀游戏，但它可不是那种一群人围坐一圈“动嘴投票”的传统狼人杀。这款游戏的核心玩法可以概括为：“既能吵吵，也能动手。”
游戏背景设定于一片被黑暗侵蚀的大陆，玩家将扮演秘火使团（好人）或冥界使徒（狼人），在10人局中展开3对7的明暗博弈。表面上是净化瘟疫、抵御怪物的冒险，实则暗流涌动——每局随机分配的3名“冥界使徒”潜伏在队伍中，伺机破坏、栽赃甚至暗杀。
https://image.gcores.com/2c4befb748141611f865caffe61f8f96-1600-900.jpg
担心自己是社恐、不擅长开口说话和推理？这在《骤影：绯月杀》中完全不是问题。
游戏引入了大量RPG和战斗元素。不擅言辞的玩家完全可以化身“战斗狂人”，专注打怪升级攒装备，用武力说话。社恐“i人”可以专注探索这个充满细节的写实世界；社牛“e人”可以在圆桌上唇枪舌剑，用逻辑掌控全场；甚至“乐子人”也能当个只顾舔包的“混子”。
它给了不同玩家完全不同的生存方式，每个人在这里都能找到属于自己的节奏。
https://image.gcores.com/367d84c8cc8c89481e71de5fda685771-1280-720.png
游戏还贴心地设计了熟练度分级系统：100小时以内算新手，100到500小时算入门，500小时以上算精通。匹配时可按熟练度选房，新老玩家各得其乐。
玩狼人杀，也要学会“武术”
玩法按照游戏内天数循环推进，三个阶段各有侧重：
白天——探索与对抗。玩家需要四散探索地图，搜寻并净化感染源（如水井、据点），同时迎战丧尸、黑暗信徒等敌人，采集素材锻造武器、学习魔法。若好人（秘火使团）阵营高效完成净化任务，可直接获胜；反之，若狼人（冥界使徒）持续污染并导致瘟疫失控，或击杀所有好人，则使狼人阵营胜出。
https://image.gcores.com/690ec3b02e10b8ea2dd9c86ec92df443-1280-720.png
夜晚——审判与博弈。全体成员回到教堂围坐圣桌前，开启长桌审判。好人通过梳理线索、互相指证投票处决疑似狼人的成员，狼人则利用谎言和舆论混淆视听，借刀杀人。第一天还会额外进行领队选举，被选中的领队将获得增益光环特效（身边队友可回复san值）和地图标点能力，引领团队方向。
绯月爆发——毁灭与生存。当感染值逼近临界，血月升起，游戏进入最终护送环。好人需掩护城主等人登上马车并抵御沿途丧尸与伏击，狼人则通过陷阱、偷袭等手段全力阻挠，在抵达港口前击杀目标即可翻盘。
https://image.gcores.com/0a4d03eea9edb6e4b761631641b0b527-1052-577.jpg
美院班底，三年磨出一剑
《骤影·绯月杀》的两位创始人均毕业于中国美术学院，团队20人中有8位是国美校友。从2022年转向游戏开发至今，团队历经三年多打磨，研发投入超千万元。
https://image.gcores.com/9d7eb8602cf01148368945142e217427-1280-720.jpg
游戏基于虚幻引擎5开发，美术风格融合中世纪奇幻与暗黑哥特元素，场景细节和角色特效均展现出较高的视觉水准。首张地图是一个充满烟火气的西方村庄，你能听到流水潺潺、踩过草丛的沙沙声，感受昼夜交替的紧张氛围。画质拉满的同时，最低配置要求GTX 1060或 RX 590，推荐RTX 3060或RX 6700。
2026年1月，游戏被Epic的MegaGrants计划选中，获得开发资助，侧面印证了其画面品质与技术实力；2月，网易雷火入股星汉明空，这一动向也让外界对这支年轻团队的创新能力与产品潜力投以更多关注；官方此前在B站发布的3条预告视频，播放总量已近千万。游戏未发先火，被不少人称为今年游戏圈的“惊喜之作”。
https://image.gcores.com/ee1196969fd7babb686133f5c3c90ec4-1164-796.png
8月25日，登岛亲自试试
目前游戏已登陆Steam页面，预计9月25日（中秋）正式上线。而即将到来的8月25日上午10点至8月31日下午5点，是游戏的首次公开限时测试。
当经典的“狼人杀”社交推理，遇上畅快淋漓的动作战斗，这场十人的智力与武力双重对决等你来战。
感兴趣的玩家现在就可以去Steam搜索“骤影：绯月杀”加入愿望单！
https://image.gcores.com/76d23b925e517c7fb38dae34988b202a-1280-720.png

items.title: Playable Control Resonant and a Dune: Awakening Update Highlight Level Infinite’s Massive gamescom 2026 Plans
items.summary: Level Infinite is bringing playable demos of Control Resonant and Dune: Awakening to Gamescom 2026, alongside

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260824/rUsOVJbuazArDAx.jpg
Level Infinite 正在 gamescom 展会上大显身手。作为腾讯旗下的游戏发行部门，该公司正前往德国科隆参加这一年度盛会，并为玩家带来了大量可试玩演示、重大公告以及涵盖 Dune: Awakening、Control Resonant 和 Hunt: Showdown 1896 等作品的粉丝体验。
我独家采访了 Level Infinite 市场营销高级总监 Anthony Croutts，了解了该公司在 gamescom 的计划，其中包括四款重磅作品、众多的合作伙伴工作室以及一些独家公告，其中一个现在就可以透露。
Hunt: Showdown 1896 gamescom 独家揭秘
“在今年的阵容中，我们将发布一些激动人心的公告，”Croutts 表示，“有些是新游戏的发布，有些是已经在运营并取得成功的游戏正扩展到不同平台。我们正在帮助工作室进行这种扩张，展示我们产品线的灵活性和深度。”
gamescom 2026 将公布关于 Level Infinite 和 Crytek 合作的撤离类射击游戏 Hunt: Showdown 1896 的全新信息。完整的揭晓内容将于 8 月 26 日星期三发布，作为 gamescom 报道的一部分。
“他们将在 gamescom 上发布重大公告，”Croutts 说，“这是一种全新的、独特的体验，让玩家在那里体验游戏玩法并与之互动对开发团队来说也非常重要。这会非常酷。”
除了激动人心的消息，Croutts 表示玩家还可以与开发人员一起在 Level Infinite 展台试玩 Hunt: Showdown 1896，这为他们提供了一个分享直接反馈的独特机会。
“这不是每天都有的机会，”Croutts 说，“这对开发人员来说是一次学习经历。他们想确保人们喜欢这款游戏，并看到玩家社区的即时反应。他们在游戏中进行了大量重大的平衡性调整，希望实时看到它在实际环境中的表现。”
Level Infinite 展台将提供四款可试玩游戏及更多内容
除了 Hunt: Showdown 1896，Level Infinite 的 gamescom 体验还将包括另外 3 款重磅发布作品、角色扮演者、赠品、独家周边和大量拍照机会。
“一进入 6 号馆，你就会看到 Level Infinite 的巨大展台，”Croutts 说，“随着你越走越近，你会看到所有不同的体验都位于核心位置。然后你可以去不同的展位区域。Control Resonant、Hunt: Showdown 1896 和 Dune: Awakening 都在那里可以互动。
“我们还准备了很多酷炫的免费赠品。当你进来时，我们会提供一张包含所有不同游戏的卡片。当你去到不同的区域，你会得到一个印章，并可以获得更多免费赠品。我们希望引导玩家参与其中。但如果你是为特定游戏而来的，它就在最显眼的位置。你一进入展台就能看到一切。”
Control Resonant 的前一小时内容将在展台提供试玩
或许最吸引粉丝的活动之一是 Remedy 开发的 Control Resonant。这款备受期待的游戏将于下个月发布，普通观众可以在展厅直接体验其开篇部分。
“对于 Control Resonant 来说，最大的吸引力就是游戏本身，”Croutts 说，“用户将能够体验前一小时的游戏玩法，这尚属首次。他们将能够进行长时间的上手体验。这在 gamescom 上总是重头戏。预告片很棒，但能亲手玩到游戏是非常特别的。”
除了试玩游戏，Control Resonant 的粉丝还可以在“The Aberrant”前合影，这是游戏中 Dylan 锤子的全尺寸复制品。如下面的独家图像所示，“The Aberrant”由实心钢制成，由专业铁匠锻造，将在 Level Infinite 展台显眼位置展示。
“我们追求的是沉浸感，”Croutts 说，“我们不只是让大家排长队玩个演示就走人。还有拍照机会、cosplayer 和只有在 gamescom 展台才能获得的独家周边。”
Dune: Awakening 主机版将在 gamescom 提供试玩
沙丘：觉醒

另一款玩家可以在 Level Infinite 展台充分体验的游戏是 Funcom 开发的 Dune: Awakening。虽然该游戏自去年 6 月起已在 PC 上推出，但玩家一直无法在其他平台上玩到。现在，该游戏的主机版本首秀将在展厅进行，该版本将于 9 月 22 日发布，并包含全新的单人“孤狼模式”。Croutts 表示，主机版绝不仅仅是简单的 PC 移植。
“工作室正在为新版本添加新的增强功能，以确保充分利用主机性能，”Croutts 说，“他们根据学到的数据添加了用户体验优化。他们从 PC 版本中吸取了很多经验，并针对主机版本修改和优化了许多内容。
“今年 Dune 系列将有一部新电影上映。所以这是一个绝佳的机会，不仅可以保持热度，还可以展示游戏是如何随着时间推移而进化和改进的。你还能在哪里玩到如此宏大的 Dune 宇宙世界？你可以沉浸其中。而孤狼模式将真正强化这一点。游戏每个月都在进化和完善。他们正在添加新内容使其变得独特，并兑现提供沉浸式 Dune 体验的承诺。”
Bohemia Interactive 的 Cosmo Tales 新预告片将在 gamescom 节目中展示
Level Infinite 的另一项参展内容是来自 Bohemia Interactive 的新游戏 Cosmo Tales。Croutts 对这款新的 roguelite 冒险游戏的内容守口如瓶，但本周晚些时候将发布该游戏的新预告片。
“我们将把解释权留给 Bohemia，”Croutts 说，“但 Bohemia 的酷点之一在于他们有完整的产品线。Cosmo Tales 是一个大家都非常兴奋的标题。我不想抢他们的风头，因为他们将宣布一些很酷的事情。我知道新预告片看起来会非常棒。我见过一些片段，真的很令人兴奋。”
虽然 Croutts 表示团队很高兴能在 gamescom 上展示一些大作，但他承认展会期间仍有惊喜尚未揭晓。但他表示，整体阵容的实力是他希望吸引人们来到展台并关注整周多次发布的动力。
“归根结底，每个人都想展示自己最好的一面，”Croutts 说，“gamescom 是最终的舞台，因为现在没有那么多全球性的游戏展了。这是最大的一个。我们很高兴展台上的大部分内容都是可试玩和上手的。你实际上可以体验到高质量的内容。”

items.summary: 【今日闪促】木村拓哉侦探动作、暗黑童话恐怖解谜、海洋冒险捕鱼经营、数码宝贝育成RPG、刷宝射击爽快开战、叙事解谜哥特动作、俯视…

content.v: 【今日闪促】木村拓哉侦探动作、暗黑童话恐怖解谜、海洋冒险捕鱼经营、数码宝贝育成RPG、刷宝射击爽快开战、叙事解谜哥特动作、俯视角肉鸽射击、卡车维修驾驶模拟、资源管理生存挑战——十款风格各异的佳作限时闪促，金币抵扣折上折！
《审判之眼：死神的遗言》由木村拓哉主演，是人中之龙工作室打造的正统悬疑法庭剧动作游戏。以现代东京为舞台，讲述侦探八神隆之对抗邪恶犯罪阴谋的故事。包含跟踪、变装、推理等丰富玩法。
《小小梦魇》是一款暗黑童话风格的恐怖解谜游戏。你扮演身穿黄色雨衣的小女孩“小六”，被困在名为“贪颚号”的巨大神秘船只中，在压抑的环境中躲避怪物、破解谜题，寻找逃出生天的道路。
欢迎访问以神秘蓝洞为背景的海洋冒险游戏《潜水员戴夫》。白天在美丽的大海里打鱼，晚上经营寿司店赚钱。伴随着个性强的同事们的故事展开的海底谜团。神秘又崭新的乐趣正在等着您。
《数码宝贝物语 时空异客》是《数码宝贝物语》系列的最新作品。你可以在追查世界毁灭谜团的过程中，一面享受横跨人类世界与异世界的冒险，以及搜集培育种类丰富的数码宝贝。
《无主之地4》是《无主之地》系列的正统续作，延续了标志性的卡通渲染画风和海量枪械系统。你将扮演全新的秘藏猎人，在充满敌意的全新星球上探索废墟、对抗疯狂强盗，揭开古老外星文明的秘密，体验无拘无束的射击与刷宝乐趣。
《布兰特爵士的生平和痛苦》是一款叙事驱动的解谜冒险游戏。你将扮演布兰特爵士，通过翻阅日记、整理信件和探索古宅，拼凑出他充满痛苦与秘密的一生，体验一段关于记忆、失去与救赎的故事。
《暗月》是一款哥特风格的动作冒险游戏。你将在被诅咒的永恒黑夜中探索，与古老的怪物战斗，解开被月光遗忘的秘密。
《致命地带》是一款快节奏的俯视角射击Roguelite游戏。你将在随机生成的地下实验室中，使用多种武器和技能，对抗变异怪物。死亡后重新开始，但能解锁永久升级，挑战高难度Boss。
《卡车机械师：危险之路》是一款卡车维修与驾驶模拟游戏。你将驾驶重型卡车穿越危险地形，途中需要随时应对车辆故障，利用工具和零件进行紧急维修，将货物安全送达目的地。
《为了人民》是一款资源管理模拟游戏。你将成为一座苏联式居民楼的住房管理员，维护建筑设施、处理居民投诉、分配有限资源，在体制与民生的夹缝中做出艰难抉择，体验那个特殊年代的日常。

items.title: Pokémon TCG: Premium Collection Sets Are in Stock at Target for MSRP
items.summary: Target just restocked this rare Pokémon TCG premium collection at MSRP, offering one of the best pack-for-pack

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/pokemon-tcg-premium-collection-restock-target-1787567720230.png
Target currently has Pokémon TCG's Mega Zygarde ex Premium Collection in stock, and for just $44.99, which is the MSRP in the US.

While the Mega Zygarde set is part of the far less popular Mega Evolution expansion, Perfect Order , it still feels like a minor miracle that you can find anything at the standard list price The Pokémon Company continues to set (almost too confidently, considering the state of the TCG right now).

$45 is also lower than the current market price at TCGplayer , but not by much. $54.25 is the listed median price, while the going market rate right now is $47.50 (that's also not a bad price if this ends up selling out at Target before you can get to it) . While it's minor savings in comparison, it's still saving, and hopefully a sign of things to come in the near future for other sets. If only we could get the same for Ascended Heroes!

But enough complaining about the market; let's have a quick chat on everything included in the Mega Zygarde ex Premium Collection. For your $45, you are getting a foil promo card featuring Mega Zygarde ex , alongside an oversized lenticular promo card of Mega Zygarde ex, a tech sticker featuring, you guessed it, Mega Zygarde ex, and eight Perfect Order booster packs to rip open. Not bad at all!

That's about $5.62 per pack, which is pretty good all things considered. Perfect Order Booster Bundles can still run you up to $40-$50 right now ( depending on where you buy ), and include just 6 packs. That's between $6.66 and $8.33, so however you work it out, you're getting a better deal on just the boosters with the Premium Collection right now.
What is Perfect Order?

It’s no secret to say reception to Perfect Order was a bit frosty, from investors and fans alike. The lack of immediate frenzy comes down to a simple sandwich effect. No, not the Legendary-restoring type.
Perfect Order is a smaller, more focused expansion of just 124 cards (including Secret Rares), sandwiched right between the massive, 295-card Ascended Heroes and the upcoming Chaos Rising expansion.

It doesn't have the traditional heavy hitters we’ve all come to expect that send the third party reseller sites into overdrive. There’s no Charizard , no Moonbreon , no Rayquaza, and no Pikachu to drive the mindless hype that usually clears shelves before the shop doors can even open.
While investors stock up on sealed cases of the big sets, the supply of them will slowly dwindle as they are completed and tucked away into private binders, never to see a TCGPlayer listing again.

But for genuine Pokémon fans who just want to rip packs and enjoy the art, or for people who actually want to play the game attached to these bits of cardboard, Perfect Order is actually the most rewarding set in years.
Perfect Order - Best Chase Cards

You only need to take a look at the chase cards in Perfect Order to see a clear pattern. Instead of one $500 card and 100 bulk Secret Rares, Perfect Order spreads the love across several high-tier Illustration Rares of fan favourite Pokémon like Clefairy and Meowth ex.

In the modern TCG era, "Master Setting" (collecting every single card in a set) has become a hobby for the ultra-wealthy. When Ascended Heroes dropped with nearly 300 cards, the odds of pulling the top 10 chase cards yourself were astronomical. That meant that resellers could hike up the prices on third party websites to meet demand, and people would pay.

This more manageable 124-card checklist is far easier to complete, which means more fans are encouraged to actually get involved again. Ultimately, why is Perfect Order the "best" investment set if nobody is fighting over it? It sounds sappy and cliche, but what if the most valuable thing we could get from Pokémon TCG was the memories we made along the way?
More Pokémon TCG Deals

Still, this isn't the first time Target has had a decent deal on Pokémon TCG and then quickly sold out, so let's also take a look at what other deals are up for grabs right now across other retailers.
The best, and most popular, pick right now the Pitch Black Booster Bundles for just $40 to purchase at Amazon, alongside Pitch Black ETBs for just $70 .
To see all the recently restocked items at Amazon, be sure to check out our custom search tracker to ensure you're buying sealed boosters that are only "sold and shipped" directly from Amazon itself.
IGN is the best place to find TCG deals

IGN's resident deals experts like Robert Anderson have over seven years of experience writing about gaming and TCG deals. In an era where finding advice from a real person is more important than ever, Robert’s expertise helps you cut through the digital noise to find genuine, money-saving offers. He pairs his experience and love of games with data-driven analysis and price-tracking tools to ensure he's only ever recommending something that's actually worthwhile.

If you're looking some no-nonsense help on saving money in a time where gaming and TCG hobbies have never been more expensive, then we'd highly recommend following him @robertliam21 on Bluesky and setting IGN as a preferred source in Google to make sure you're getting the latest updates, from him, and the rest of the IGN Shopping team.

Robert Anderson is a Senior Commerce Editor for IGN. Based in London, UK, he is a qualified journalist with a First Class degree in BA Journalism and over seven years of professional writing and editing experience. You can usually find him lost in open-world RPG games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077 , or tinkering in Planet Coaster and Two Point Museum. Outside of gaming, he enjoys reading comics (especially Superman, Batman, and Spider-Man), taking photos, and keeping up with the latest in film and TV.

items.title: 想克隆出异性的自己吗？日本科学家首次从雄鼠克隆出雌鼠
items.summary: 近日，日本山梨大学完成世界首例“雄性克隆雌性”实验。科学家通过CRISPR基因编辑技术，首次成功将雄性小鼠胚胎转化为雌性，并培育出具有生育能力的雌性克隆小鼠。这一成果发表于《自然》子刊，被学界视为哺乳动物生殖生物学领域的

content.v: 近日， 日本山梨大学完成世界首例“雄性克隆雌性”实验。科学家通过CRISPR基因编辑技术，首次成功将雄性小鼠胚胎转化为雌性，并培育出具有生育能力的雌性克隆小鼠。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260824/1787553306_940061.jpg
这一成果发表于《自然》子刊，被学界视为哺乳动物生殖生物学领域的一项里程碑式突破。夏威夷大学生殖生物学家莫妮卡·沃德评价称：“此前从未有人做到过这一点。”
该技术的核心在于对Y染色体的精准剔除。研究团队从小鼠雄性体细胞中提取细胞核，通过CRISPR系统靶向切割Y染色体上的关键序列，使其在细胞分裂过程中自然丢失。
随后，这些仅含X染色体的细胞被植入去核卵母细胞中，通过体细胞核移植技术构建胚胎。
由于细胞性别决定机制中，Y染色体的缺失会触发胚胎向雌性方向分化，最终发育为具有XX核型的雌性个体。
这一过程并非简单“移除”性别决定基因，研究人员表示，Y染色体上除SRY基因外，还存在多个影响精子发生和代谢的调控元件。
单纯敲除SRY虽能诱导性别逆转，但无法保证后续生殖系统的正常发育。因此，团队采用了全染色体消除策略，确保胚胎在发育早期即获得完整的雌性遗传背景。
经基因测序确认，所有克隆小鼠均未检测到Y染色体残留序列，且其卵巢结构、激素水平及自然交配产仔能力均与正常雌鼠无异。
科学家指出，人们普遍有一种固有观念，认为大多数物种必须有雌性和雄性才能繁衍，然而这项研究表明，这一传统观念可能需要改改了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Warhammer 40,000 Audiobook Includes AI Training Warning — Read Out by the Narrator
items.summary: Games Workshop is famously anti-AI, but I was still caught by surprise when the narrator of my new favorite Wa

others.title: Ray Chase, the voice of Cyclops in X-Men '97, has '1,000 freaking hours' in Slay the Spire and is running a 'smell build' in Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2: ' I wear perfumes and walk into battle with my fancy boy outfit'

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/trazyn-1787566439248.jpg

Games Workshop is famously anti-AI, but I was still caught by surprise when the narrator of my new favorite Warhammer 40,000 audiobook read out a warning about training AI systems on the novel itself.

AI models training on books without permission has become one of the big topics in the tech space. Last week, a report by 404 Media alleged that Amazon was buying “massive quantities of books, scanning them for AI training data, and destroying them in the process.”

Last summer, it emerged that Anthropic had shredded millions of physical books to train its Claude AI model. The secret initiative, called Project Panama, was unearthed in a lawsuit brought by a group of authors against Anthropic, which eventually agreed to settle for $1.5 billion despite the ruling largely siding with the AI company on fair use.

And in October last year, a federal court advanced two new theories of infringement against ChatGPT-owner OpenAI in a lawsuit brought by authors including Game of Thrones’ George R.R. Martin. No final summary judgment ruling has been issued yet.

Games Workshop’s websites are plastered with AI warnings. The Black Library website, which is the official home of Games Workshop’s book business, carries the message: “Any use of website content to train generative artificial intelligence (AI) technologies is expressly prohibited.” There are detailed AI warnings in the legal sections of Games Workshop websites, too.

But it was at the end of audiobook version of Robert Rath’s superb Necrons novel, The Wicked and The Warped, that I was surprised to hear narrator Richard Reed himself read out a crystal clear AI warning: “This recording is copyrighted to Games Workshop 2026. All rights reserved. May not be used or reproduced in any manner for text and datamining activities, or developing or training artificial intelligence models or systems.”

That’s the first time I’ve heard an AI warning actually read out by a Black Library narrator (I’m not sure if it’s the first, but there is no warning read out at the end of the audiobook version of Dan Abnett’s Hive, which released in May).

It is in keeping with Games Workshop’s messaging on AI so far. In January, Games Workshop banned the use of AI in its content production and design process , insisting that none of its senior managers were currently excited about the technology. Then, in July, Games Workshop reiterated its anti-AI stance, and revealed it had launched investigations into recent marketing gaffes that some suspected were AI , to ensure staff were playing by internal rules.

“As noted in our November 2025 half year report, we are not being complacent on the topic, we are carefully monitoring what others are saying and doing,” Games Workshop CEO Kevin Rountree said of at the time.

“We are not using AI at Games Workshop in our product design nor on the creation of our IP, this will protect the integrity and ownership of our IP. We have made a few human errors on the depiction of our products in our product marketing in the year, they were investigated fully to ensure that AI had not been used and that all our staff are following our internal policies.”

The question is, can Games Workshop actually do anything to prevent AI companies from training their models on its books? The tech world argues fair use when it comes to hoovering up content, not just from books but from pretty much all creative output. So far, despite the high-profile lawsuits and investigative reports, that approach appears to be working. So, to truly test Games Workshop’s resolve here, it would probably have to issue a lawsuit against an AI company itself, or at least threaten one with legal action if it believes its content has been used to train a model.

And there is evidence to suggest AI models are trained on Warhammer books. In March 2025, an investigation by The Atlantic found that Meta allegedly pirated millions of books to train its AI. Black Library authors were among those subsequently horrified to discover that their novels were in LibGen , the pirated-books database that Meta used to train AI. A quick search shows pretty much all of Robert Rath's Warhammer novels are in there.

Meanwhile, fake AI-generated Warhammer books have become a real problem , with unlicensed Warhammer 40,000 books complete with clearly AI-generated covers and apparent AI-generated text available on various retailers.

Games Workshop boss Kevin Rountree recently admitted that AI was automatically included in third-party software “whether we like it or not,” which makes it difficult for Games Workshop to say definitively that it is not using AI outside of its own Warhammer studio. This is “something we are just going to have to potentially live with and monitor,” Rountree added.

“We are proud to deliver consistent great returns employing great people (many of them hobbyists themselves) celebrating with other hobbyists in the real world,” he continued. “Our business performance is still built on staff development and hard work with very little waste.”
Image credit: Games Workshop.
Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

content.v: 8月21日，我终于走进了廷根。
这是快手旗下弹指宇宙开发的欧式古风神秘学MMO《诡秘之主》公测的日子。它从内测开始就把噱头拉得很足：UE5引擎打造，耗资12亿，还有它背靠的这个极受欢迎的IP有大量的原著粉丝。有很多书迷无论之前是否玩过MMO，都会为了这个略带克系风味的蒸汽朋克世界，还有里面熟悉的角色前来尝试。
我对《诡秘之主》原著只是略有了解，但对目前国产MMO中较为少见的欧式风格和“虚幻5”引擎的效果很感兴趣。我也想知道，在MMO的玩法和各种框架都基本定型的前提下，《诡秘之主》能不能做出点新东西。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-24/8846a8beec38cd73.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在实际上手之后，我的期待大概被满足了一半：论世界氛围，《诡秘之主》做得确实量大管饱，但内容填充似乎欠缺了一些沉浸感；至于战斗和休闲玩法，它提供了很多便利，“肝”度上下限都很高，但整体体验却停在了“又一款MMO”的门槛上。
换句话说，《诡秘之主》目前的体验没有太大的缺点，但也没有太多可圈可点之处。何况它还比其它MMO面临着一个额外问题，即IP受众的反响。考虑到这个项目的投入规模，这些放在其他地方的“小毛病”，就显得有些扎眼。
但万一，团队的预期就是求稳呢？毕竟，这是快手继不尽人意的《无尽梦回》后进军游戏行业最大手笔的尝试，并且声称“活下去就是胜利”。
■ 眼花缭乱的世界
《诡秘之主》的游戏开篇进度比较快。完成序章，进入廷根这座颇有雾都伦敦风范的架空城市，游戏的绝大部分玩法都立刻呈现在玩家眼前。
主线方面，有玩家作为刚刚获得非凡能力的“新生者”需要面临的冒险故事，还有遵循原作故事、体验原作男主“愚者”克莱恩过往经历的原著线。
在此之上，则有大世界中各种各样的支线任务。这些任务散落在城市的各个角落，可以在骑着自行车闲逛的时候偶遇，内容包括隐藏空间的宝箱、小型解谜游戏等等。
各种多人副本也很熟悉。根据等级，游戏会开放不同类型的主题副本供玩家选择。比较特殊的是一个叫做“世界灾厄”的百人大战，由百名玩家对战一个多阶段、拥有许多全场技能的Boss，定时开放。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-24/8266a8bed53ed4fc.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
这些设计在MMO中都比较常规。不过《诡秘之主》有个比较有趣的类似“里世界”的地图。廷根原本就是一个表面光鲜亮丽、内里腐烂不堪的地方。从开场CG和剧情都可以看出来，制作组似乎很想强调这一点。因此，除了通常所在的“秩序世界”之外，玩家可以通过地图进入一个单独的“城市暗面”，在这里会有更多涉及到城市秘密的支线接取。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-24/3406a8bedbd8fcc8.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
另外，目前游戏没有通常意义上的家园系统，但是玩家可以建造并经营自己的城堡。同理，还有各种加入教团、家族、与其他玩家结成羁绊等等MMO中常规的社交系统。目前看来，“安魂诗社”是个相对来说非常有用的教团。这毕竟是个带有克系要素的世界观，玩家在各个副本中遭受攻击都有可能掉“理智值”，“安魂诗社”成员可以帮忙回复理智值，并且是在大街上闲逛，随机看到谁就可以帮谁回复，可以说是非常老好人了。
到这里为止，我已经说了很多次“常规”，因为《诡秘之主》在这所有的方面的确都表现得十分常规。要说它在哪里给我留下了深刻印象，就是廷根这座城市整体呈现出一种不惜成本的“堆量”特质。密密麻麻的副玩法，密密麻麻的行人、NPC和同服玩家，密密麻麻的抽取要素和养成道具……它几乎确保你每时每刻都有有事情做、有故事看，屏幕上有可交互的内容。
但这些内容本身显得没有那么新奇。
一个比较重要的方面是，不知是否因为原著的存在，《诡秘之主》的主线似乎放弃了大部分涌现性叙事的路数，在序章就把世界观的许多内容都抖了出来。这类游戏主角通常会经历的“我是谁”“我的能力从何而来”“我要到哪里去”的标准三问，在《诡秘之主》中虽然也提了，但存在感不强。
换句话说，玩家一进入廷根，就对所谓愚者、塔罗会、非凡现象等等一大堆本应该十分神秘的东西，被灌输和接受得极快；而开篇就有若干看起来很大佬的角色轮番过来送职位、送资源、送情报，这对一个号称神秘学、带有克系要素的世界观来说，对沉浸感的影响相当致命。
现在主线也就更新了3个任务的量，内容基本没有展开，这种难以沉浸、缺乏神秘感的感受还比较初步；而且，我一定程度上能理解，如果开局太“谜语人”，制作组会担心没看过原著的玩家对世界观一头雾水。但它的确会影响我继续探索故事的好奇心。
在支线任务的设计上，目前也大多处在中规中矩的范畴。要说有什么新鲜体验，一些支线会要求玩家扮演其它角色体验他们的故事，这一定程度上综合了部分传统RPG游戏的优点。一些支线还采用了双线叙事，能让玩家从不同人物的视角去看待同一个事件。但这类任务本身的任务链仍然中规中矩，基本还是“从A到B，说几句话、送个东西”这样的不断重复。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-24/1246a8bef8c2fd08.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在众多分支中，原著剧情给人的感觉是最好的。在这一点上，我个人的感受和一些“原著党”的感受重合了。可能因为它最接近传统RPG的推进方式，还原度也不错，沉浸感也基本来自于此。
所以，《诡秘之主》这个游戏给我的第一印象是“这个世界确实精彩，但这份精彩和我关系有限”。如果不是遵照新手任务和每日任务的话，我可能很难找到去自发探索的动力。
■ 可便利可复杂的战斗与养成
和几乎所有MMO一样，《诡秘之主》为各类玩家都准备了对应玩法，涵盖多人PvE副本、多人PvP，以及人相对少的单/双人本。职业系统吸收了原著设定，但仍然沿用战法牧贼的经典框架。
我选择的是窥秘者开局。这个职业属于中近程兼备的施法者，算是一个用起来比较好玩的混合职业。在技能上，基本兼顾给自身减伤、给敌方增伤以及范围攻击，在单人战斗中比较全面舒适。所有小技能都可以给大招积攒能量，整体技能循环的逻辑非常好理解。只不过，因为施法距离较近，在遇到比较强大的敌人时会有一点生存压力。
一些比较辅助性的，或者说配装机制的一部分，是需要花费资源或者课金抽取的。最重要的是“人脉”，许多重要NPC会为主人公提供各种形式的战力加成；另一个是“秘偶”，相当于一个有主动技能或者被动增益的魔宠。需要额外花心思刷取的，还有各种拥有随机词条的装备，珍贵封印物也有各种奇特的负面效果。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-24/4066a8bee9103305.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
因为刚开服大多数人都还处在养成期，副本难度不高，还没有碰上太多需要玩家严密配合的地方。比起战斗本身，现在的PvE副本更注重机制，里面加入了很多类似小游戏的玩法。比如第一个日常本就囊括了类似“吃豆人”的关卡，还有原著知识提问关卡——组队时一个原著党都没碰到的话，那真的会相当致命。
与比较好理解的打法相对应，技能种类、装备词条、养成材料只能用眼花缭乱来形容，很难从无比庞杂的机制中比较方便地总结出来自己想要围绕什么样的中心玩法构筑。我玩了两天可能连一半名词都没有认全。如果是愿意研究这个、追求极限战力的玩家，为了拿足资源，这几天基本上每天都需要把各种日常本、日活任务和当天开放的新主线支线全部扫一遍，到了特定等级之后再去大地图扫荡一遍宝箱。肝度绝对不弱。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-24/6646a8bedbdb19ad.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
好在《诡秘之主》几乎提供了同类游戏中最方便的辅助养成系统。不仅有一键升级、一键强化，战斗的时候也可以用“一键辅助”自动放技能。
与之相对应的，探索部分也做得非常便利。包括但不限于大地图中自动寻路，随处可见的马车传送和无处不在的任务点引导。可以说，《诡秘之主》意识得到自己的内容有多么繁多，所以才在便利性上毫不吝啬，甚至能让纯“休闲党”无论在探索方面还是战斗方面都基本不用费事。有意思的是，游戏的每日任务中干脆就有一栏叫“躺赢”，基本都是由休闲任务组成。
那休闲玩家可以做的事情，自然就是盖房子、换装、社交。《诡秘之主》从宣发开始就以角色捏脸的颜值作为卖点，开服推出的服装一个比一个华丽。官方账号甚至十分直白地发帖表示，“开发组深知外观党玩家是中国最长情的玩家群体之一”，可见他们在皮肤和社交上的重视程度。
所以，如果要让我给《诡秘之主》在战斗和养成方面的主要玩法一个整体印象，大概是“肝痛”和“躺赢”的上下限都非常高。至于各种系统本身，和同品类MMO基本保持在同一水准，甚至在友好程度上又优化了不少；但要说有什么新鲜之处，或者说“集大成”，又显得有点太夸张。从目前的社区反馈来看，喜欢的玩家大多在夸它玩起来舒适，迷茫的玩家在继续迷茫，不喜欢的玩家则主要在批评它的既视感，算是非常符合它核心玩法的特征。
■ 何去何从的宇宙？
在撰稿期间，《诡秘之主》的官方账号连番发布了庆贺帖子，包括首日玩家破百万、紧急追加服务器组，两日玩家破500万；游戏在8月21日iOS总畅销排名升至第31位。官方还发布长文表示，“《诡秘之主》是2026年MMO赛道目前唯一吃鸡者”，“iOS渠道收入仅占15%，其余都来自PC端和安卓”。同时，官方宣布将发放更多福利，包括外观1折券和50%折扣券。
从官方措辞来看，弹指宇宙或者说快手对《诡秘之主》的期待并不是一个爆款、乃至一个巨大的成功；再加上传言中开发团队的很多成员都来自老牌MMO大厂，《诡秘之主》目前这种中规中矩、不算惊艳但也挑不出太多错处的表现就显得非常合理了。看起来，团队对IP本身寄予厚望。一款不出大错的产品，一个足够吸引人来尝试的理由，就能保证游戏在公测期维持一定的热度和话题度。
如果进一步联系团队的运营风格，这件事就显得更有意思。官方账号连续发文的“接地气”的程度整体就给人感觉非常快手。“活下去就是赢了”“恭喜快手正式成为一家游戏公司”……对一个研发六年、开服三四天的项目来说，这种自我定位和淡淡的自嘲口吻让一部分玩家觉得有趣，但更多人关注的仍然是游戏中承诺过的种种福利什么时候发——他们是真的有点担心游戏的后续运营周期够不够长。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-24/2186a8bef10b1ae7.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
这一切都让《诡秘之主》看起来像是一块凭借规模效应和工业能力，为快手继《无尽梦回》之后再次敲开游戏行业大门的砖头。这块砖不一定是金砖银砖，但能盖房子就是好砖。对快手来说，可能“做过UE5大制作”和“做过超大型MMO”这两点就是一块较有含金量的招牌。
一个佐证是，截至2025年第四季度，快手财报中显示，“以短剧漫剧、小游戏为代表的内容消费行业以及AI应用行业是驱动线上营销服务收入增长的主要动力”。自研游戏在其中基本没有占据什么篇幅。
但考虑到《诡秘之主》是一款自带IP热度的MMO，而游戏在外观、社交上明显投入了很多功夫，未来是否能打通直播、电竞等等快手更擅长的领域，其实是一个值得观察的现象。毕竟，团队自己显然也知道，走传统MMO的老路非常艰难，现在的市场也相当残酷。开服3天500万玩家并不意味着能就此判定项目的生死；真正要看的还是之后持续更新的内容量与玩家留存。

items.title: 触乐怪话：宇宙尽头的餐馆
